summary: /var/log/supervisor/ holds awx-callback-receiver, awx-daphne, awx-dispatcher, awx-rsyslog, awx-uwsgi, awx-wsbroadcast, failure-event-handler, supervisord, wsrelay, ws_heartbeat and rsyslog_configurer logs plus service stdout. Related logs are under /var/log/nginx, /var/lib/pgsql/data/pg_log and /var/log/redis; custom logging goes in /etc/tower/conf.d/.
